summary: The StudentPlacement domain model represents a student placement configuration, including contacts, scheduling, assignment details, and associated metadata. The model merges information about instructors, supervisors, program, course, site, service, and destination involved in the student placement process. It also accounts for group arrangements, workflow states, key changes, exceptions, and communication management.
purpose: To manage and track the details, workflow, participants, scheduling, and validation/exception conditions of student placement assignments within the broader placement and educational coordination system.

workflows.name: Student Placement Retrieval and Assignment
steps: StudentPlacements.GetByStudentID called with StudentID and SessionID.
Stored procedure 'StudentWelcomeSearch' returns placement data as rows.
StudentPlacement instance is populated from database fields and derived logic (e.g., conditional formatting, contact parsing).
Contact fields are prioritized/selected based on available IDs in order: Discipline, StudentInstructor, Destination, Service.
Contact data is parsed from delimited fields for discipline/student instructor contacts.
Group instructor, supervisor, and multiple supervisors are parsed and linked using associated IDs, names, phones, and emails.
Schedule details (block dates, days of week, shift codes, times, hours, etc.) are assigned.
Flags for changes, alerts, withholding entities or placements, amendment presence, and document info are set.
Assignment is finalized, and updated tooltips are rendered if changes are detected (supervisor, destination, date).

business_rules: Effective contact information is determined by prioritized order: discipline > student instructor > destination > service.
Contacts are parsed from delimited database fields (ID|LastName|FirstName|Phone|Email).
Withholding flags enable or restrict visibility for destination coordinator, preceptor, instructor, and placement with associated number of days.
If any entity (supervisor, destination, date) changes, 'UpdatedToolTip' is set and communicates change since last login.
Placement type formatting checks if type equals 'Group' and uses localized resource if so.
validations: Valid UUIDs are required for linkage via keys.
Contact fields are only populated if corresponding ID is not zero.
Delimited fields must be properly split and converted to appropriate types.
calculations: ShiftLength: calculated from ShiftCode, StartTime, EndTime using Shift.ShiftLength.
ShiftType: calculated from AmendmentExists, VariousTimes, and ShiftCode using Shift.ShiftType.
Withhold flags (boolean) and withhold days (int) are set based on database values.
conditions: AmendmentExists affects display fields and logic for shift type.
UseAltLanguageFields, if true, uses alternate language strings for service labels.
If any changed flag (SupervisorChanged, DestinationChanged, DateChanged) is true, UpdatedToolTip is set.
system_behavior: StudentPlacement objects are loaded in batches for a student.
Dynamic tooltips and alert messages are generated and updated based on recent changes.
Contacts are selected and formatted for display based on hierarchical logic.
Data access is performed using session context and parameterized stored procedures.
exceptions: Corrupt/invalid contact data results in default/empty fields.
Delimiter parsing errors may leave contact lists empty.
Missing site alternates to empty string for ParentSite.
